_comment: Single source of truth for every host-side port this stack publishes. Edit a value here to resolve a conflict with something else already using that port on your machine, then re-run start-dev.ps1 (it regenerates the .env block docker-compose.yml reads before starting containers). Container-internal ports are not listed here on purpose: they're private to the Docker network and never conflict with anything on your host, so changing them buys nothing.
